text:
maria: Quick thread for release notes prep. Scope: finalize release blurbs, fix link-image rot, and ensure SDK snippet parity for streaming examples.

joel: I did a sweep; found 9 broken links and 2 images 404ing under /integrations and /guides. Opening redirects for the top 4.

devon: I'll take Python snippets. Which path are canonical snippets living in? /samples/snippets ok?

maria: Yes, prefer /samples/snippets in this repo so docs builds pull the same files. Add a note in the PR linking to that.

kate: FYI the docs build failed locally because integrations/s3.md had an unclosed code fence. Fixed in a tiny PR: #3421.

linkbot: auto-check: 2 pages flagged for broken images (/integrations/s3, /guides/quickstart). See ops/linkbot-2026-03-22 for mapping.

sam: For the changelog entries use the template at /docs/release-notes/template.md. Include a short blurb, user impact, migration steps, and known-issue if applicable.

maria: Drafting two blurbs: (1) streaming stability improvements (server-side and browser notes), (2) routing fallback policy tweak (less aggressive failover). Will push drafts + snippets by EOD.

joel: Also call out SDK rename: client.create_stream -> client.stream (node). I'll add inline migration snippet showing old vs new.

devon: Adding Python note about tokenization behavior change in 1.0; will include sample using with client.stream(): for sync and async variants.

kate: After PRs merge, run full linkcheck. Ops suggested adding stable asset paths (/static/assets/v1/) to avoid future image breakage.

maria: Good call. I'll include the stable-asset-path note and the known-issue: "Dedicated cold-start after kernel invalidation" with workaround (warm-up traffic) linking infra/1234.

sam: Timeline: PRs open by EOD, review tomorrow morning, merge before docs deploy at 10am PT. Tag PRs with relnotes-draft so I can pull entries.

maria: Thanks all. I'll post the release-notes draft in #docs for review once PRs are up.
